statement: Monte Carlo simulations at n=8 and p=1/8,...,1 illustrate concavity and concentration under independent and exact +/-1 block-correlated Gaussian settings.

models.fixed_cardinality: all size-k subsets with p=k/8, matching p=|S_j|/n and Theorem 1.5
models.bernoulli_conditioned_nonempty: independent set membership with probability p, matching the Erdos-Renyi caption; condition on nonempty sets because max over an empty set is undefined

verification_rule: For both models and all three correlation regimes, require no four-standard-error concavity violation, increased concentration from p=2/8 to p=1, convergence of every optimizer, agreement of all finite-m multi-seed estimates with the population reference, an independent pseudo-random checker, and rejection of the invalid substitute.
falsification_rule: A four-standard-error positive second difference reproduced by the independent checker, or failure of concentration under either paper-consistent model, prevents verification and triggers a dedicated falsification audit.
